title: Pit full of kids at For the Record
body: Saturday, Oct 10, 2026, we played For the Record in Beaumont with Zegovia and Psycho Jenni. It was an all-ages show, and a big crowd of young fans kept a mosh pit going for half of our hour-long set, singing the lyrics right back at us. Thanks to everyone who came out, and to Jon and the For the Record crew for having us.

title: So it seems last night at For The Record there was one helluva show.
body:
So it seems last night at For The Record there was one helluva show. Man the crowd was outstanding. The night started off with Psycho Jenni going acoustic style. I think they showed how good of a band they truly are with their performance, bravo. Then Zegovia took the stage. These guys brought me back, someone in the band has to love Fugazi for sure. They blew it out the park, words like electric, energetic are only a few that describe them. Superb band. Then old ETA gave them a shot of some adrenaline to close it out. Thanks John, you do amazing stuff. Till next time. Oh yeah
